quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: JUST IN: The Orlando Magic and Kevin Porter Jr have agreed to a deal, league sources told HoopsHype. KPJ averaged 17.4 points, 7.4 assists, 5.2 rebounds, and 2.2 steals per game for the Milwaukee Bucks last season. Agent Sam Permut of Roc Nation finalized the deal.

items.title: The Wizards will face a severely injury-depleted Magic team tonight. In addition to having Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda out, the Magic have listed Anthony Black as out for tonight's game because of right ankle injury management.
items.author: Josh Robbins
